points.point: The Vault assigns R&S ZNA to component-level satellite payload testing covering converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay and phase measurements
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions converters/mixers and phase/group delay for SATCOM generally, but not ZNA or the satellite component-level assignment/list

points.point: Group delay measurement on frequency converters without LO access (two-tone technique) is a key VNA capability for satellite transponder/converter chains
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions group delay for frequency-converting devices, but not no-LO-access two-tone transponder/converter-chain capability

points.point: ZNA supports true parallel and coherent data acquisition for antenna array / antenna test systems from 100 kHz
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions phased arrays and phase/coherent needs, but not ZNA true parallel/coherent acquisition or 100 kHz start

points.point: High dynamic range is a stated ZNA key performance figure: >129 dB spec, 147 dB typical with options, up to 170 dB with full 2-port correction
points.label: partial
points.why: states high dynamic range importance, but gives none of the ZNA figures

points.point: mmWave converter support via rear-panel LO out extends S-parameter coverage without an external signal generator
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions mmWave/wide frequency generally, but not rear-panel LO-out converter support or no external generator

points.point: Pulsed-signal S-parameter measurement exists as option R&S ZNA-K7 (requires ZNA-K17 plus pulse modulator)
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions pulsed-RF S-parameters, but not ZNA-K7/K17/pulse modulator details

points.label: missing
points.why: no satellite supply-chain mapping, ZNA/ZNB3000, antenna makers, or G/T work

points.point: For UAV antennas the Vault maps ZNB3000 to high isolation measurement and OTA passive testing
